rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical size and also for an older or bigger child.
Use this specifically when “big” means fat or overweight.

example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 fei4 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when “big” means important or significant rather than physically large.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this when big means adult, especially when contrasting an adult with a child.

example.english: The boy is big now—he’s already an adult.
example.jyutping: go3 zai2 ji5 ging1 sing4 nin4 laa3
